g.text: latching switch, INPUT_PULLUP, 50 ms debounce; LOW = Manual
momentary push button, INPUT_PULLUP; LOW = start auto cycle
RS232 line to scale (differential pair, twisted)
RS232 line from scale (differential pair, twisted)
feed here — do not power from USB at the same time
single common ground for the whole board
U2 pin 10, DB9-5 and both button returns
1. SW1 selects the operating mode: LOW (pressed) = Manual — the web UI ON/OFF buttons drive the relays; HIGH (released) = Auto — weight thresholds drive the relays.
2. SW2 is only read while SW1 is HIGH (Auto mode). A LOW pulse on GPIO14 sets both relays ON; the cycle then runs until the scale reports a weight at or above the matching threshold.
3. Relay modules must be the 5 V low-level-trigger type, matching the 3.3 V ESP32 GPIO. If a module turns on at 0 V, add an NPN inverter or use a 3.3 V coil module.
4. MAX232 charge-pump capacitors C1–C4 and the V+ storage cap C5 are all 0.1 µF ceramic, fitted close to the device. Add a 0.1 µF bypass cap at pins 9/10.
